'''Paul van Horne''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dutch National Championship]] on 21 May 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal]], according to Johan Haneveer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d796">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championship-21-05-00d796/ dutch-championship-21-05-00], DeckTech (Johan "Joh" Haneveer, 22 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championship-21-05-00d796/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
